'''2011 Luxembourg Regionals Angelo Consoli DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Angelo Consoli]] at [[2011 Luxembourg Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Angelo
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
